fact: Orange Botswana opened a data centre at the Botswana Digital and Innovation Hub science park in Gaborone, after a reported $5.2m investment; the document gives no date beyond its own (2023-12) and says the telco launched it.

Orange Botswana's Gaborone data centre is described by Orange as an Uptime-certified Tier III facility, billed as the first Tier III in Botswana (operator statement, reported by SDxCentral; date is the article's).

Mascom's Innovation Centre data centre is open to external customers and sells colocation, cloud, IaaS, disaster recovery and managed services, per Mascom's CEO; no opening date given, article dated 2026-07-13.
Mascom's CEO states the Mascom Innovation Centre data centre is Tier III certified internationally (operator statement; certifier not named); article dated 2026-07-13.

BoFiNet's Digital Delta Data Centre is operating, with government services migrating to it, and BoFiNet's CEO invited SOEs, parastatals and private organisations to migrate their systems there (hosting, storage, internet exchange); article dated 2026-05-06.

Xalam Analytics estimates about 6+ live commercial data centre facilities in Botswana in 2025, with about 3MW of live critical IT load available to third-party customers and about 50% occupancy; no facility is named.

DCD reports Botswana has launched the Digital Delta Data Center, a 1,000 sqm colocation facility in Gaborone owned by the government and operated under BoFiNet; no event date given, so the published date is used.
DCD describes the newly launched Digital Delta Data Center (BoFiNet, Gaborone) as Tier-III certified without naming the certifier; no event date given, so the published date is used.
BoFiNet launched the carrier-neutral Digital Delta Data Centre in Gaborone in the week of the article, a ceremony attended by the Minister of Communications and Innovation.
The Uptime Institute awarded the Digital Delta Data Centre (BoFiNet, Gaborone) Tier III Certification of Constructed Facility in October 2025, per BoFiNet's acting CEO.
BoFiNet is urging businesses to sign up to its new Digital Delta Data Centre in Block 8, Gaborone, offering pricing, uptime and access; the date used is the published date.

BTC's Sentlhaga Data Center is an operating facility that houses customers' ICT platforms and hosts BTC's Cloud Connect offerings; it is described as Tier II, Uptime certified (not Tier III), 120 sqm floor, 5 kW per rack (page dated by proxy, 2020-11-04).

The Botswana Digital & Innovation Hub (BDIH) data centre is operating as a carrier-neutral colocation facility renting quarter, half and full racks and power to tenants, with BoFiNet, VBN and BTC connected (page dated by proxy, 2020-02-27).

ITWeb Africa, citing BoFiNet, describes the Digital Delta Data Centre (DDDC), run by BoFiNet, as the state's first and only Uptime Institute Tier III-certified, carrier-neutral facility of its scale; the certification date is not given, so as_of is the article's publication date.
BoFiNet, 100% government-owned, introduced the carrier-neutral Digital Delta Data Centre in Gaborone in November 2025 and runs it; the article is dated 2026-03-06.
The Ministry of Communication and Innovation launched the Digital Delta Data Centre in Gaborone on 25 November 2025 (BoFiNet facility); the article does not say it sells to outside customers.
The minister stated the Digital Delta Data Centre attained Uptime Institute Tier III certification for a constructed facility on 23 October 2025.
BoFiNet's Digital Delta Data Centre was launched in Gaborone on 25 November 2025, and is said to enable secure storage, web hosting and cloud computing for businesses and government.
The communications minister described the Digital Delta Data Centre as a Tier 3 certified data centre able to accommodate businesses' needs (stated by the minister, certifier not named).

BTC Limited (BTCL) launched the Sentlhaga Data Centre in 2020, an Uptime Institute Tier II certified facility housing customers' ICT platforms and BTCL's Cloud Connect offering; the article calls it the first certified data centre in Botswana (Tier II, so not Tier III).
Data centres dataset: Digital Delta Data Centre (DDDC) (Botswana Fibre Networks Ltd (BoFiNet)), colocation/carrier-neutral, in service; this document names it (published 2026-03-18).

BoFiNet CEO Geoffrey Seleka says the Digital Delta Data Centre is a carrier-neutral facility open to all licensed operators and cloud service providers, serving government, state-owned enterprises, parastatals and private companies.
BoFiNet CEO Geoffrey Seleka says the Digital Delta Data Centre is Uptime Institute Tier III certified, with 99.982 percent availability.
